name: How long does a typical bathroom lighting upgrade take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical bathroom lighting upgrade take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a bathroom lighting upgrade depends on its scope. A simple fixture swap might take a few hours. However, if the upgrade involves new wiring, installing recessed lights, or relocating switches, it could take one to three days. More extensive remodels that include structural changes or multiple electrical circuits might extend beyond that. Your contractor will provide a more precise timeline after assessing your specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: A basic bathroom lighting upgrade can take a few hours, while more complex projects with new wiring or recessed lights may take one to three days, depending on the scope.
